history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration issue guidance to ensure that the pre-appointment vetting procedure of senior leadership is enhanced by ensuring that newly appointed senior staff members have implemented the relevant recommendations from the Ethics Office upon assuming their United Nations duties and that the implementation of relevant recommendations should be verified by the Executive Office implementing the contract of the appointed senior staff member.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Executive Office of the Secretary-General shared with the audit team a memorandum dated 26 November 2025 from the Chef de Cabinet to all heads of entity, including executive heads of United Nations funds and programmes, launching a new procedure under which the executive office/local human resources administration of each entity would be responsible for following up with regard to the senior appointment and confirming to the Ethics Office and the Executive Office of the Secretary-General that the recommendation of the Ethics Office on conflict of interest has been implemented by the appointed senior staff member. This procedure is effective as of the date of the memorandum.
history.board_assessment: Given that the proper procedure has been launched, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
